manifesto: Every record carries the five-stage manifesto: proven problem (evidence), root cause, precise fix, tests, and demonstrated resolution.

defects.problem: 76 sm:/xl: utilities across 45 .vue files (UI-08…UI-12, shared shell, landing scaffold) compiled to NOTHING: every sm:grid-cols-2 stayed one column at every width, so the Platform dashboard and many forms rendered as full-width stacked boxes.
defects.evidence: Compiled index CSS contains no `sm\:grid-cols-2`, `xl\:grid-cols-4` or `sm\:inline` rule while `md\:grid-cols-2` exists; before capture super_administrator.dashboard shows single-column KPI stacks.
defects.root_cause: style.css sets --breakpoint-sm/xl/2xl: initial (only the token-owned md=768 and lg=1025 screens exist, ADR-021); older pages were authored with Tailwind's default screens.
defects.fix: Class-attribute-scoped remap sm: -> md: (tablet floor) and xl: -> lg: (desktop floor) after proving no line already carried the target prefix; AppShell context label fixed by hand.

defects.problem: Platform Billing Settings printed the literal text 'entry.hint' under all three general-settings fields.
defects.evidence: before capture super_administrator.billing-settings; GeneralSettingsSection.vue:121 `help="entry.hint"`.
defects.root_cause: Static attribute instead of a binding (missing ':').
defects.fix: :help="entry.hint"; repository-wide scan found no other instance.

defects.problem: Platform Get Started evidence read 'defines a undefined-day trial' when the server omitted a figure.
defects.evidence: cap-mid super_administrator.get-started; platformGetStartedStore.ts:236 String(undefined).
defects.root_cause: String() of an optional numeric field.
defects.fix: An absent figure is stated as absent ('no default trial length recorded'), never rendered as a value.

defects.problem: The Front Office payment 'confirmation modal' never opened or closed: its content and the 'Record payment' button were always rendered inline at the bottom of the page.
defects.evidence: RecordPayment.vue renders <SvDialog> with no import; Vue resolves it as an unknown element whose children always render.
defects.root_cause: Missing component import — not an error to vue-tsc or the production build.
defects.fix: Import SvDialog; the existing review -> confirm tests already follow the intended modal flow.

defects.problem: Merchant Administrator, Branch, HR and Finance Get Started pages rendered no <h1>.
defects.evidence: before captures: h1 count 0 on 4 pages (cap-before metrics).
defects.root_cause: RoleGetStarted rendered the orientation hero (which owns the h1) only for Front Office, Personnel and Audit; the checklist heading is a section <h2>.
defects.fix: One orientation map for all seven merchant accounts; each renders SvOperationalHero with a distinct title.
tests: ui-16 axe sweep asserts exactly one h1 on all 132 live pages

defects.problem: The notifications control on the Super Administrator header was Charcoal on Deep Earth Brown (~1.3:1), effectively invisible on all 17 platform pages (WCAG 1.4.11 needs 3:1). axe does not test icon contrast.
defects.evidence: before capture super_administrator.dashboard header; SvIconButton ghost = text-sv-text.
defects.root_cause: A light-surface control placed on the theme-invariant brown header without the header owning its glyph colour.
defects.fix: AppShell scoped rule sets the trigger glyph to white on the platform header in both themes.

defects.problem: Status chips on Plan Management, Plan Prices, Preferred Fee Rules, Subscription Plans and HR Compensation failed AA contrast in dark mode (axe serious color-contrast).
defects.evidence: ui-16 axe dark 360: subscription-plan `.bg-cream`, billing-preferred-personnel-fees `.bg-primary/15`.
defects.root_cause: Legacy `text-brand-deep` is #4A2208 in BOTH themes; `--color-cream` aliases surface-warm, which is #273340 in dark. A stale comment in Compensation.vue claimed the pair stayed cream.
defects.fix: Adaptive `text-sv-text-heading` on the tinted chips; comment corrected.

defects.problem: The Branch dashboard pulse panel faded from brown to white at its corner.
defects.evidence: before capture merchant_branch.dashboard; class `to-brand-citrus/80`.
defects.root_cause: `brand-citrus` is not a configured colour, so the gradient end compiled to nothing (transparent).
defects.fix: Branch dashboard recomposed onto SvOperationalHero (token gradient).

defects.problem: 11 more template utilities compiled to nothing: error text (`text-danger`, `text-danger-strong`) rendered in the default colour, the file-upload button had no background (`bg-savannah-orange`), timeline dots lost their ring (`border-sv-surface`), search focus/hover states were inert.
defects.evidence: compiled-utility audit against the built stylesheet: 11 missing (SvFileUpload, BranchCalendar, BranchAudit, CompensationHistory, HrAuditActivity, GlobalSearch, ServiceSessionList, InvoiceCreate, InvoiceDetail, MerchantProfile).
defects.root_cause: Names from an earlier palette that the token-driven Tailwind config never defined.
defects.fix: Each mapped to its token-backed equivalent (sv-error-fg, sv-brand, sv-focus, sv-surface-raised, sv-text, sv-text-muted, sv-warning-fg); audit now reports 0.

defects.problem: On a 360px phone the fixed footer was 125px tall while every page reserved 88px, so the bottom ~37px of EVERY mobile page sat under the footer; on desktop the footer was 61px against a 56px reserve.
defects.evidence: ui-16 responsive sweep: 131/132 pages failed at 360px with 'reserved 88px, footer 125px'; footer measurement 1025px: 61 vs 56.
defects.root_cause: The footer's legal row wrapped freely into three lines on mobile and the 44px social targets plus padding exceeded the desktop token — content height, not the token, decided the footer's size.
defects.fix: Deterministic mobile composition (copyright line, links on at most two lines at 11px, 44px social row) and tokens sized to the measured worst case: mobile 7.25rem, desktop 4rem; tablet unchanged (72 = 72). One token still drives both the footer and the reserve (ADR-024).
tests: ui-16 responsive sweep footer-reserve assertion at seven widths and 200%

defects.problem: Content butted directly against the preceding header on pages whose SvStateBoundary carried a top margin.
defects.evidence: after-1 captures of the four rebuilt dashboards; 56 SvStateBoundary call sites pass a class.
defects.root_cause: The success state rendered the slot bare; a multi-root slot cannot inherit attributes, so the caller's class applied only in loading/empty/error.
defects.fix: One wrapper <div data-testid="sv-state-success"> in the success state.

defects.problem: Every gated sidebar entry printed its full gate sentence as a permanent 3–5 line block; the Merchant Administrator sidebar ran to ~1,600px and its eight gated rows out-weighed the fifteen live ones.
defects.evidence: before captures of all seven left-nav accounts.
defects.root_cause: The stacked navigation rendered the gate statement inline at full length.
defects.fix: GatedNavigationEntry: label, a compact 'Unavailable' marker and the statement clamped to one line, expanding on hover/focus; the statement stays in the DOM as the entry's aria-describedby.

defects.problem: The Super Administrator's eight header groups wrapped onto a second ragged row under the brand at 1440px.
defects.evidence: before captures of all 17 platform pages.
defects.root_cause: The groups shared one flex row with the logo, page title and profile control.
defects.fix: A full-width navigation strip inside the same header (still header-primary, ADR-018).

defects.problem: The desktop sidebar grew with the page: it scrolled away on long pages and ran under the fixed footer on short ones.
defects.evidence: before captures (sidebar continues beneath the footer band).
defects.root_cause: No sticky/internal-scroll treatment.
defects.fix: Sticky sidebar at >=1025px with internal scroll bounded by the footer token.

defects.problem: On detail routes (merchant, invoice, staff record) the shell title fell back to the account name ('Super Administrator').
defects.evidence: cap-mid super_administrator.merchant-detail header.
defects.root_cause: The title came only from visible navigation links; detail routes are contract pages without a link.
defects.fix: Fallback to the canonical contract label for the route.

defects.problem: Raw machine tokens were shown as labels: in_force, pending_setup, suspended_billing, 'scope all_new_merchants', 'status active', lowercase action buttons ('pause').
defects.evidence: cap-mid SMS billing, subscription operations, internal access, promotions.
defects.root_cause: SvStatusBadge requires human text but callers passed the token.
defects.fix: utils/statusLabel (shared, personnelStatus delegates to it); promotions/offers as labelled fact strips with sentence-case actions.
tests: SmsBillingSettings.spec.ts updated to the intended label
tests/e2e/phase-20c.spec.ts promotion status cases now assert the label and the absence of the raw token

defects.problem: Gate statements read 'readiness is closed.. No payment…'.
defects.evidence: before capture merchant_administrator.dashboard billing alert.
defects.root_cause: The server sentence ends with a full stop and the template appended another.
defects.fix: The trailing stop is trimmed before the follow-on sentence (Merchant and Branch dashboards).
tests: ui-09 'never fabricates zero reporting' spec still passes

defects.problem: Eight places formatted business timestamps in the viewer's zone/locale ('8/12/2026, 8:00:00 AM'); the session table and platform audit showed raw ISO strings.
defects.evidence: cap-r2 merchant_branch.branch-day; grep of toLocaleString without timeZone.
defects.root_cause: new Date().toLocale*String() without Africa/Nairobi.
defects.fix: utils/dates formatDate/formatDateTime/new formatTime (Africa/Nairobi) at every site.

defects.problem: UI-08 browser fixtures predated the published API (unit_price_minor vs unit_cost_minor, state vs status, trial_days vs default_trial_days, …), so screenshots showed 'undefined', 'NaN' and blank badges that the real API cannot produce.
defects.evidence: cap-mid SMS billing, subscriptions, internal access, promotions, billing settings; generated api.ts schemas.
defects.root_cause: Stub drift — fixtures were never checked against the OpenAPI types.
defects.fix: Stubs aligned to SmsBillingRuleResource, the usage row, PlatformSubscription(Invoice)Resource, PlatformAccessMembership/InvitationResource, PreferredPersonnelFeeRuleResource, PromotionalDiscount/FreePeriodOfferResource and PlatformBillingSettingsResource; the 'warn' severity stub became the enum's 'warning'.
tests: ui-08 spec unaffected (asserts none of the stale values)

defects.problem: Five tested shared primitives (SvTonalPageHeader, SvOperationalHero, SvStatTile, SvLeadRecord, SvMaskedIdentity) were invisible to the component contract; SvOperationalHero had no test.
defects.evidence: componentRegistry.ts listed 54 components, none of the five.
defects.root_cause: UI-13/UI-14 built them in-phase and deferred registration.
defects.fix: Registered with honest contracts; ComponentContractTest requires them; SvUi16Primitives.spec covers SvOperationalHero.

inherited_closures.problem: No browser evidence had ever exercised the origin the product deploys to; every Playwright spec runs against a Vite preview with a stubbed API and a harness-installed account context.
inherited_closures.evidence: docs/frontend/audits/ui-01/defect-register.csv (UI01-PROV-003, open, owner UI-16); playwright.config.ts baseURL http://localhost:4173.
inherited_closures.root_cause: The only checks against the built production images were HTTP smokes (ui02/ui05/ui06); no real browser loaded the served shell and bundle with genuine account Host headers.
inherited_closures.fix: tests/e2e-origin/production-origin.spec.ts + playwright.origin.config.ts: Chromium maps servana.ke and *.servana.ke to the built edge; per host it proves the shell, fingerprinted JS/CSS with correct MIME, the server-resolved account context, light first paint, the sign-in page and the anonymous deep-link redirect, with no page error or failed request. Wired into the CI Docker job after the UI-06 smoke.
tests: negative control: the same gate against the Vite preview origin fails 16/16
inherited_closures.remaining_risk: Not yet executed in CI (Codex Prompt 2). The deployed DNS/TLS origin is UI-17.

inherited_closures.problem: UI-01 captured a visual baseline only and made no accessibility assessment; no release-wide accessibility or reviewed visual baseline existed.
inherited_closures.root_cause: Scope record — accessibility was owned by the later release-wide audit.
inherited_closures.fix: Axe on all 132 live pages in light (1440) and dark (360) with 0 serious/critical; keyboard, zoom, reduced-motion and theme checks; 106 reviewed candidate visual baselines with a negative control. UI-01 images remain the as-built comparison point, never approved baselines.
inherited_closures.remaining_risk: No screen-reader software pass (UI-17 / product owner).
